title: The Takedown of an Unbeatable Monster
description:
Aleksandr Karelin: 887 wins, 2 losses, three Olympic golds, nine world titles - and six consecutive years in which nobody scored a single point on him.
Then, in the Sydney 2000 final, American Rulon Gardner - raised on a Wyoming dairy farm, no major titles - beat him 1-0. Karelin never wrestled again.
